_prereg: PAN-37 part 2: seeded-bug calibration set for agent-run code reviews, frozen 2026-10-10 BEFORE generation.
Purpose: measure how often a reviewer (an agent or a model) finds a real bug and how often it raises a false
alarm, so review findings can be weighted by measured reliability instead of trusted. The set is built from the
PAN-34 primary tasks (functions of the program whose own test file sees them), so every seeded bug is one the
program's tests detect: a 'known bug' with ground truth.
source: the 142 PAN-34 primary tasks (manifest 46e2343aa, amendment A2), their sandbox and worker copies

operators.cmp_flip: one comparison operator swapped: < <-> <=, > <-> >=, == <-> !=, in <-> not in, is <-> is not

mutation_rule: the mutated expression's source segment is replaced by the unparsed mutated expression; every other character of the module is unchanged (no reformatting tells)
selection: tasks shuffled with random.Random(37); per task one site drawn with the same generator from all applicable sites; a mutant is KEPT only if its task's test file FAILS with it (killed); stop at 40 kept mutants; then 20 CLEAN items (unmutated functions) from tasks not used for mutants, same generator
secrecy: items (the code a reviewer sees) and the answer key (mutated line, operator, original and mutated segment) are written to the M2 lake only (C:/Prometheus-data/pan/lake/reviewcal/), never to the repository or the database; their sha256 are committed so the key can be checked when revealed

scoring.hit: on a mutant item, a finding that cites a line within +-2 of the mutated line
scoring.miss: a mutant item with no hit
scoring.false_alarm: a clean item with any finding claiming a bug
scoring.metrics: recall = hits / 40 and false-alarm rate = false alarms / 20, each with a Wilson 95 percent interval; a reviewer whose recall interval lies below 0.5 is reported as unreliable for unsupervised review
